Product Profile
Pratikshya, released in 2006 after being developed by OUAT, Odisha, is suitable for late sown conditions for rainfed medium land, featuring late maturity and semi-dwarf stature with medium slender grains. Specifically recommended for late-sown conditions in rainfed medium lands, it demonstrates moderate resistance to brown spot, sheath rot, sheath blight, leaf folder, and white-backed plant hopper, while being resistant to gall midge and stem borer.
